title: Line 70: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 70 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at line 70 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
